date.description: UTC; exact block timestamp when the exploit tx is known, else the documented date

lossUsd.description: verified USD loss (USD-pegged stables at 1:1); crypto-only figures are excluded from the dataset

victimContract.description: the contract containing the exploited flaw

exploitTx.description: onchain anchor: the attack transaction; its block timestamp is the incident time

documentedLastChange.description: for architectures emitting no standard upgrade event: the documented change date/tx the age is measured from

nonStandardUpgradeArchitecture.description: diamond/module-registry/beacon victims whose changes emit no EIP-1967 event; age may be overstated

duplicateOfCuratedIncident.description: registry row whose (chain, contract) also appears in a curated row; excluded from the curve

status.description: OK, or the exclusion reason (ATTACKER_DEPLOYED, NO_CREATION_INFO, DEPLOY_AFTER_INCIDENT, NOT_MEASURED, ...)

codeAgeSeconds.description: incident - last change; the curve knot

basis.description: deployment (onchain) | last of N upgrade events (onchain) | documented change
